I have referred to the example code provided by RSWAT team, such as the code for calibrating flow and sediment parameters on a monthly scale. However, TN is in the output.rch file and is different from watout, and I have not been able to successfully modify the code. If you could provide a specific example of how to modify userReadSwatOutput.R for monthly TN calibration or provide any advice that could guide me in the right direction, I would greatly appreciate it.

parts:
This could be becuase:

1) your time format should be "00:00" instead of "0:00"
2) check the length of your obsered data and the length of Output/Core_1/out_var_1.txt.
If possible, I would advise you posting your Output/Core_1/out_var_1.txt. and obs_var_1.txt (of course you could use "fake" values to protect your data privacy, I just want to see if the format is correct or not)
